scope: Six full-song private construction performances; mixing refinement and mastering, no new melody or runtime replacement.

criteria.requirement: Exact six construction master and 80 input-stem hashes; preserve the note/tempo/instrument performance and prior versions.
Review lead, support, bass and percussion duties; compare only coactive stem windows and retain intentional rests.
Record every gain/EQ decision and its cue-specific purpose; spectral measures are diagnostic, not an aesthetic grade.
Inspect player position, depth, full-band correlation, low-side energy and mono retention; no score identity depends on width.
Measure integrated loudness, range, crest, true peak and gain-reduction amount/time; preserve source section contrast.
Keep exact song length, entrances and source timeline; inspect the existing one-second delivery tail fade.
Provide mono, quiet-level and band-limited proxies; distinguish these from physical-device or human listening evidence.
Verify finite lossless/listening audio, hashes, codecs, editable-session recall and private archive integrity.
Complete new-candidate source/tone, clarity, fatigue, soundstage and full-song listening before approval; never infer a listening pass from meters.
